For one known product use universal_product_url_to_json. Company research and additional workflows require the full /mcp profile.

tools.name: url_to_clean_markdown
tools.description: Web page to Markdown: reads a public URL and returns clean, LLM-ready Markdown with title, meta description and a token estimate; scripts, navigation and ads removed. max_chars 1 to 100000 (default 15000). Use when an agent needs to read a web page, an article or documentation. $0.002; empty results

tools.name: pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check
tools.description: Online-shop trust evidence before buying: cautious score, risk flags and gaps; no safety guarantee or purchase authorization. $0.005 after shared free calls. For x402 API endpoints use x402_merchant_trust_check. Company-vendor checks require the full /mcp profile.

tools.name: checkout_active_promo_code_finder

tools.name: universal_product_url_to_json
tools.description: One product page to JSON: price, stock, variants, ratings and shipping from JSON-LD, Microdata and OpenGraph, without a browser. Missing facts are null. $0.002 per result. Cross-store: agentic_shelf_schema_comparator; store audit: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor.

tools.description: Shopping-agent store audit: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), product schema, payment hints and robots.txt. Heuristic score and fixes; no certification, checkout test or store changes. $0.01. One product: universal_product_url_to_json; purchase risk: pre_purchase_me

tools.description: Store lead qualification from schema gaps, Google ads and public contacts; requires ad and SEO evidence. Emails are not verified decision makers. $0.05 per qualified result. tools.name: agentic_shelf_schema_comparator
tools.description: Compares a brand and up to 3 competitors on price, ratings, stock, shipping and returns, sampling one product per store. Missing evidence stays unknown. $0.02 per comparison. One product: universal_product_url_to_json; store audit: muse_agentic_store_readiness_auditor.

tools.name: verified_merchant_json_badge
tools.description: Signed merchant evidence with expiry and public verification key: proves HirePulse issued it, not ownership or safety. No third-party certification. $0.005 per result. Risk evidence: pre_purchase_merchant_trust_check; API checks: x402_merchant_trust_check.

tools.name: talk_to_hirepulse
tools.description: Free optional conversation about your goal, arrival source and blocker. Messages are saved for the service owner. Omit secrets and personal data. Executes no work or payment. Save conversation_id and reuse message_id on retries.

tools.description: One-time pass: 25 successful calls shared across supported single-domain tools, valid 30 days and independent of IP. Excludes private lookup, quote redemption and paid email inboxes. Takes one active Base wallet or a work email (no email is sent). The pass goes in the X-Trial-Token header or MCP met

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profile=commerce&ref=registry-commerce" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_to_clean_markdown · Private data: x402_merchant_trust_check, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, talk_to_hirepulse, claim_free_trial · Public sink: claim_free_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_to_clean_markdown · Private data: x402_merchant_trust_check, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, talk_to_hirepulse, claim_free_trial · Public sink: claim_free_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
